values.guide.adjust.body: Review the proposed changes when a rebalance appears. Check how activities move across days before accepting the new schedule. Edit your available hours in Study plan settings.
values.guide.adjust.title: Adjust an overloaded plan
values.guide.anki.body: Choose Import to select a deck package and review the available options. Return to Cards to study imported material. Choose Export to create a deck from your cards and download it.
values.guide.anki.title: Import or export an Anki deck
values.guide.appearance.body: Choose a theme in Appearance settings. Adjust the motion preference separately to reduce animation while moving around the app.
values.guide.appearance.title: Set appearance and motion
values.guide.ask.body: Open Ask Naadi from the dock or the phone's center tab. The conversation can carry page context. To ask about particular words, select them in the reader and choose Ask.
values.guide.ask.title: Ask about the current screen
values.guide.cards.body: Recall the answer before revealing the back. Rate how easily you remembered it. Your rating affects when the card returns; follow the source link to revisit the underlying lesson when available.
values.guide.cards.title: Review due flashcards
values.guide.chapter.body: Choose a chapter from this list. Its coverage counts tell you how many sections and study resources it contains. The reader opens a section you can resume later.
values.guide.chapter.title: Open a chapter
values.guide.chips.body: Questions opens the practice builder for this exam. Cards opens your review queue. The numbers describe the chapter's coverage; your due queue follows your own review schedule.
values.guide.chips.title: Move from reading to practice
values.guide.expand.body: Use the expand control in the side panel to fill the screen. Restore the panel to read alongside the conversation. Your thread, draft and pending attachments carry across both layouts.
values.guide.expand.title: Expand a conversation
values.guide.expenses.body: Add an amount and currency, associate the expense with a stage or task and choose its payment status. Read subtotals by currency when reviewing costs across stages.
values.guide.expenses.title: Reconcile planned and paid expenses
values.guide.export.body: Open Data settings to choose the data you want to export. Follow the export job's status, then download the available files. Keep the downloaded copy somewhere you control.
values.guide.export.title: Export your work
values.guide.file.body: Open a ready file from your library. Processing and attention states on the file card tell you whether you can open it yet or need to review the import first.
values.guide.file.title: Read imported files
values.guide.find.body: Enter a remembered phrase to find notes and related saved material. Open a result to return to its context. Clear the query to browse the collection again.
values.guide.find.title: Search your notes
values.guide.flow.body: Read the activities in order and open an item to start. Use the weekly planner when you need to move study time or inspect a different day.
values.guide.flow.title: Follow today's plan
values.guide.generated.body: Open the generated library to see available outputs and their status. Inspect an item before using it in your study. Generation requires an enabled, configured service.
values.guide.generated.title: Find generated study material
values.guide.highlights.body: Use the highlights rail to find passages you marked. Open a linked passage to see the surrounding material. Detached highlights retain the quoted text for reference.
values.guide.highlights.title: Revisit highlights
values.guide.history.body: Open chat history to choose an earlier thread. Start a new chat for a separate topic. Review any proposed changes in the conversation before confirming them.
values.guide.history.title: Return to a conversation
values.guide.ink.body: Choose Write to annotate a passage or sketch across its margins. Pick a preset or open the colour wheel, choose a shade and brightness, then tap Done. Use the eraser to revise a mark. Turn ink off to select text or move to the next section.
values.guide.ink.title: Write directly on a page
values.guide.intake.body: Choose a supported file or use an available intake option. Review the resulting file card for processing status. If an item needs confirmation, inspect its details before continuing.
values.guide.intake.title: Bring in your material
values.guide.memory.body: Open Assistant settings to review remembered information and suggestions. Inspect the available actions on an entry before changing what the assistant can use in later conversations.
values.guide.memory.title: Manage assistant memory
values.guide.milestone.body: Read upcoming assessments and milestones alongside your weekly workload. Revisit your target date and available hours in Settings when your study schedule changes.
values.guide.milestone.title: Track milestones
values.guide.mock.body: Choose a mock exam and review its start options. During timed or exam sessions the assistant and search are unavailable. Use the block's own navigation and timer until you finish.
values.guide.mock.title: Take a timed assessment
values.guide.next.body: Use Next to advance one section and the back arrow to revisit the previous one. Open Contents in the chapter header to jump farther. Your position saves as you read.
values.guide.next.title: Turn the page
values.guide.notebook.body: Open an existing notebook or create one from the shelf. Add pages for separate topics, choose a paper style, and use the page strip to move between them.
values.guide.notebook.title: Organize notebooks
values.guide.notes.body: Open Page notes to work alongside the text. A note linked to a selection keeps its quoted context. On smaller screens the notes open in a sheet.
values.guide.notes.title: Keep notes beside a lesson
values.guide.official.body: Choose the official resource for your exam. These links take you to the publisher's site. Return to Naadi to continue your own question blocks and track the work in your plan.
values.guide.official.title: Find official practice material
values.guide.offline.body: Open Offline settings while connected and download the available study material. Review device storage there. Changes made offline wait for a connection; open sync status to inspect pending or failed writes.
values.guide.offline.title: Prepare for offline study
values.guide.past.body: Open a previous block to revisit its results. For finished timed blocks, review individual questions and use the available filters to focus on responses that need another look.
values.guide.past.title: Review a completed block
values.guide.pdf.body: Use the page control to move directly to a page. Use the pen tools to annotate the document. Where region questions are available, select a region to discuss that part with the assistant.
values.guide.pdf.title: Navigate and mark a PDF
values.guide.practice.body: Choose an exam and the filters you want to study, check the available count, then start a block. In tutor mode, submit an answer to unlock the explanation and linked reading.
values.guide.practice.title: Build a practice block
values.guide.privacy.body: Review what stays on this device and what syncs to your account. About also explains AI use, sources, embedded video privacy and the installed application version.
values.guide.privacy.title: Understand storage and privacy
values.guide.read.body: Scroll through the section, including figures and tables. Select a passage to highlight it, quote it in a note, make a card or ask Naadi about the selection when available.
values.guide.read.title: Read and annotate a section
values.guide.ready.body: Review the estimate alongside recent practice. When evidence is still limited, the tile explains what is pending. Use the system breakdown to choose a topic for your next block.
values.guide.ready.title: Read your readiness estimate
values.guide.results.body: Use the question grid to find a missed, flagged or unanswered item. Open it to review the response and explanation. Compare the system breakdown and timing with your previous assessments.
values.guide.results.title: Inspect a completed assessment
values.guide.resume.body: Open the resume tile to pick up the activity you last worked on. For a lesson, the reader restores your saved position. Check the activity title before opening it.
values.guide.resume.title: Resume a session
values.guide.schedule.body: Review the target date and available study hours. Save your changes, then return to the planner to inspect the updated workload and milestones.
values.guide.schedule.title: Update a study schedule
values.guide.search.body: Open Search or press Control+K or Command+K. Enter a topic and inspect the grouped results. A question result opens a tutor item so you can answer before reading its explanation.
values.guide.search.title: Search across Naadi
values.guide.settings.body: Use the settings groups to change your study plan, appearance, ink tools and assistant preferences. Account contains profile and session controls. Available groups depend on enabled features.
values.guide.settings.title: Manage your account and preferences
values.guide.stage.body: Use the stage rail to move between parts of the pathway. Open a task to inspect its requirements, cited source and last-check information before making plans.
values.guide.stage.title: Explore career stages
values.guide.systems.body: Choose your exam, then a body system to narrow the chapter list. Use Show all systems to clear the selection. Each chapter lists the material available to study.
values.guide.systems.title: Find lessons by system
values.guide.task.body: Open the next task, update its status, and set your own due date. Check the estimated fee and add a planned or paid expense in the appropriate currency. Use notes for your own follow-up.
values.guide.task.title: Track dates and costs
values.guide.title: How Naadi works
values.guide.vault.body: Choose a document or capture one with the camera where supported. Open an existing item to check it. The vault requires a connection, even when task updates can be saved offline.
values.guide.vault.title: Store pathway documents
values.guide.video.body: Pause at the moment you want to remember. Choose the note action beside the player, enter your observation, and save. Its timestamp lets you return to that moment later.
values.guide.video.title: Save a timestamped video note
values.guide.week.body: Inspect the dates and study items in your weekly plan. Select a day or activity to see its details. Use the next activity action to begin the work scheduled for you.
values.guide.week.title: Plan the week
values.guide.whiteboard.body: Add a whiteboard page for freeform diagrams. Switch pages with the strip and use the notebook's export control when you want a PDF copy.
values.guide.whiteboard.title: Sketch on a whiteboard
values.highlights.detached_body: The text these were on changed or is gone. Each one is kept here with what you highlighted.

values.ink.lab.intro: Write with Apple Pencil, a stylus, a finger or a mouse. The lab measures input-to-paint latency, shows which input features this browser offers, and stress-tests scrolling on a page with {count} strokes.
values.ink.lab.many_body: Every surface on a page shares one canvas memory budget. Mount {count} pages of ink and scroll: off-screen pages give their memory back and repaint when they return.

values.ink.lab.protocol_1: Turn on Slow-motion mode: thick black ink on paper and a frame counter above the page.
values.ink.lab.protocol_2: Record the iPad screen with another phone at 240 fps, close up, Pencil tip and ink both in frame.
values.ink.lab.protocol_3: Draw fast, short strokes. In the video, count frames from the tip touching to the first ink pixel.
values.ink.lab.protocol_4: Each frame is 4.17 ms; the target is 20 ms or less (about 5 frames). Note the median of 10 strokes.
values.ink.lab.protocol_5: Repeat with Predicted ink off. Record both in docs/PROGRESS.md with the iPad and iPadOS version.
values.ink.lab.sample_intro: Write anywhere on this page. On plain text the marker sits under the words; on a page with a table, a figure or a PDF it blends over them.
values.ink.lab.scroll_result: {fps} fps · p95 frame {p95} ms · {long} long frames of {frames}
values.ink.lab.slowmo_hint: High contrast and a frame counter for 240 fps video.

values.official.headline: Official
values.official.how_1: Take the official sample questions early to see the format, then again close to your exam date as a timed run.
values.official.how_2: Use an NBME self-assessment as a checkpoint every few weeks, under exam conditions, and review every item you missed.
values.official.how_3: Treat Naadi's practice exams and readiness estimate as practice, not as a prediction of your official result.
values.official.intro: The free official sample questions and the NBME self-assessments are the closest thing to the real exam. They belong to the USMLE program and NBME, so Naadi links to them on their own sites and never copies them.
values.official.legal: Links only. Sample questions and self-assessments are © FSMB and NBME. Naadi is not affiliated with or endorsed by the USMLE program or NBME.

values.settings.about_ai_1: The assistant and the generators use free-tier models. The companies that run free models may log the prompts they receive.
values.settings.about_ai_2: Names and email addresses are removed from anything sent to a model.
values.settings.about_ai_3: Vault documents never reach a model.
values.settings.about_sources_body: Every chapter, question, image and video in Naadi names its source and licence. Naadi does not contain text from First Aid, UWorld or NBME. Videos play in YouTube's own player.
values.settings.about_stores_1: Your account, study plan, answers, flashcard reviews and notes are stored in Naadi's database and can be read only by you.
values.settings.about_stores_2: Files you upload, your handwriting and images you generate are kept in private storage under your account.
values.settings.about_stores_3: Vault documents are private. They are never sent to an AI model, and they are in an export only when you tick that box.
values.settings.about_stores_4: Pages you open are also kept on this device so they work offline.
values.settings.about_stores_5: You can download all of it at any time from Data & export.
